observations.code_quote: | `$mcp_interface`                                | `mcp` from an MCP server on `@posthog/mcp` (TS 0.22.3+), `webmcp` from a tool a web page registered through WebMCP and posthog-js captured in the browser. WebMCP events carry no transport, client, or harness properties, and `$mcp_server_name` is the page hostname. Absent on older events, so treat a missing value as `mcp`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
